title: Step 28 was a harness click timeout; engine state, moves, energy (0) and resource bar ('Energy 0 Runes 3/4') are identical to step 27 and consistent, no pendingChoice, Recruit token correctly shown exhausted/rotated. The only rules-facing oddity visible: every card in player-1's hand (Retreat, Garbage Grabber, Vanguard Captain, Noxian Emissary, Mushroom Pouch) carries a prominent 'HIDE' button eve
expected: card.js:195-204 (W13) sets hideBtn = `<button class="card-hide-btn" ...>Hide</button>` whenever `zone === "hand" && isOwned && card.id` — no check for the Hidden keyword or for an available hideCard move — and it is emitted on every hand card at line 247. Rule 811.1/811.1.c defines "Hide" as the Discretionary Action whose prerequisite is the Hidden keyword, and the engine implements a real `hideCard` move (moves/play/hide.ts, registered in moves/cards.ts:29). So a client-only localStorage cosmetic toggle is labeled with the rules term "Hide" on non-Hidden cards, exactly as claimed.
